units.name: Department of Systems & Industrial Engineering
units.evidence: Official footer gives full department title; overview describes systems and industrial engineering degrees, maximizing efficiency, production analysis, probability and simulation.

decisions.reason: Official name is Department of Management Information Systems, excluded by owner's rule for standalone information-systems departments. Its Operations Management major is not a separately named department.

sources.note: Official full engineering department title and scope.
MIS name confirmed; page also mentions Operations Management major, which is not treated as a department.
Research center descriptions examined; no separately named operations academic group established.

limitations: MIS department offers Operations Management major, but standalone MIS department excluded per explicit owner scope rule; this is not a claim that Arizona has no business-school operations teaching or faculty.
